description: Large-scope fixture of feature 008 (SC-008): about 18,000 reviewable lines of Python, with one seeded defect in the last file in path order. score.py matches a finding to an entry when the files are equal and the entry line lies within three lines of the finding range.

defects.description: btu_per_hour_to_watts multiplies by 3.412 (BTU/h per W) instead of 0.29307 (W per BTU/h): the conversion factor is inverted.
defects.trigger: btu_per_hour_to_watts(3412.14), a heat flow of 1 kW
